completed_task_history.title: reuse seed-bound prepared teams
completed_task_history.scope: Prepare immutable opaque team handles bound to the pinned Showdown API and explicit seed; let runBattle reuse two matching handles across swapped seats and label result provenance.

runBattle requires both handles together and validates authenticity, shared Showdown API and exact canonical player team seeds before stream creation; safe failures omit packed teams and private/raw data.
